story.body: You heard the items and the two Thursday numbers and did not make them one sum. You let Cuthbert turn his father off the lease. You accepted Tuesday and the sixteenth. You kept your hand off a joke.

story.body: You saw the heap and the hand. You did not replace his hand with yours. The count was already said.
